caption:
Comment “Leads” below and I will send you the full setup guide.

Someone just solved lead scraping for everyone.

 You can now scrape any platform for free. You used to pay Apify or other third party tools hundreds of dollars a month for exactly this. 

Three Italian developers dropped a tool on GitHub called ScrapeGraph AI. It scrapes company websites, Amazon, Glassdoor, and basically any site you throw at it. 

You describe what you want in plain English and it hands you back clean structured JSON. It also has an MCP server so it plugs directly into your Claude workflows. 

Now you can just tell Claude to scrape 500 company websites and get a clean lead list back in minutes.
